# ESR Tech Blog Demo

This repository contains a static frontend concept for an ESR Tech blog listing page.

## Important status

- This is not a complete company website.
- It is not an official source for company services, pricing, careers, leadership, awards, policies, or contact information.
- Many navigation links point to pages that are not present in the repository.
- Search, pagination, newsletter signup, and contact actions may be visual-only and non-functional.
- Article dates, categories, summaries, and images may be placeholder or archived content.

Do not submit personal information, business inquiries, payment details, credentials, or newsletter data through an unverified static demo.

## Technology

- Static HTML
- CSS
- jQuery and plugin scripts
- Responsive blog-card layout
- Local and remote image assets

## Repository

https://github.com/Nischhalsubba/Tech_Blog
